from collections import defaultdict
c=sqlite3.connect("analytics.db")
users={r[0]:(r[1],r[2]) for r in c.execute("select user_id,platform,is_test from users")}
evs=c.execute("select user_id,name,ts from events").fetchall()
STEPS=["install","tutorial_complete","first_match","purchase"]
by_user=defaultdict(list)
for uid,name,t in evs: by_user[uid].append((name,t))
res=defaultdict(lambda: defaultdict(set))
for uid,lst in by_user.items():
    if uid not in users: continue
    platform,is_test=users[uid]
    if is_test: continue
    lst.sort(key=lambda x:x[1])
    prev_t=None; reached={}
    for step in STEPS:
        best=None
        for name,t in lst:
            if name!=step: continue
            if prev_t is None or t>=prev_t: best=t; break
        if best is None: break
        reached[step]=best; prev_t=best
    for step in reached: res[platform][step].add(uid)
platforms=sorted(res)
funnel={p:{s:len(res[p].get(s,set())) for s in STEPS} for p in platforms}
biggest={}

        prev=f[STEPS[i-1]]; cur=f[STEPS[i]]
        rate=(cur/prev) if prev else 0.0
        if rate<best_rate: best=STEPS[i]; best_rate=rate
